capabilities: Edits GEDCOM records through graph, timeline, list and source modes
Autocompletes tags and validates against GEDCOM 5.5.1 and 7.0 while typing
Navigates to definitions, finds references and renames cross-references
Links notes to records with hover previews and embeds
Exposes the parsed document to other plugins through an API
extras: The genealogy interface is beta and can be turned off in settings; a demo vault with a four-generation family file is included; the full guide is hosted elsewhere; loading remote images is opt-in and off by default.
problem: Obsidian has no understanding of GEDCOM files, so genealogy data can only be edited as unvalidated plain text without navigation or a family view.

relations.evidence: To test beta releases, use BRAT with this repository URL

summary: GEDCOM language support that edits .ged genealogy files with validation, autocomplete, navigation, and graph, timeline and list views.
